findings: Overlays on other apps: firstuse-overlay (network/EULA over Settings/qcards/voice), accessibility-overlay (Mute/Multikey long-press over any app), self-diagnosis/tvuserguide/installation/store-demo/multiviewsettings/notificationcenter/magicnum are overlay-type windows, signlanguage-avatar is topui over content. Settings is also overlay and gets Wizards/support apps launched on top of it with appReturn.

Duplicates by bundle: firstuse-overlay.main = firstuse/index.html (target network|eula); accessibility-overlay.main = accessibility/index.html (quickMode); learning and universalqcard1/2/3 all load universalqcard/index.html and differ only in tile colour/title and the admanager slot (QCardUniversal2/3/4, QCardLearning); their dirs are ~57-59 KB (appinfo, icons, qcardinfo). oobe is separate code (post-setup welcome), not a copy of firstuse. com.webos.app.membership and overlaymembership share the same Loader shell.

First-boot chain: surfacemanager launches firstuse (AppInterfaces.qml:152). On completion firstuse launches membership (LG Account login, targetPage mainLogin) if general terms accepted and not logged in, else oobe; on tuner models it can go to channelsetting/connectionwizard first. firstuse steps: location, accessibility, method(remote|mobile), network, eula, analysis, confirm, install, ai, ambient, swupdate, signature, parental.

Settings key does NOT open com.palm.app.settings: openSettings() sends systemUIManager launch of com.webos.app.quicksettings (compositor QuickSettings QML) unless configd uhdBroadcastBox. The Option key (Qt.Key_Option) toggles com.palm.app.settings directly. Many Settings rows are only launchers (appReturn) for the wizard apps in this slice.

Launched automatically without being asked: firstuse (first boot), oobe (after firstuse), familycare (service launches app and alert on boot/end-of-use when time limits are configured), softwareupdate (USB/expert mode only, trigger source not found), cmp-client/billing.app/homeconnect.app (service-started). universalqcard service pops a modal 'Watch Now / Close' reminder alert (New & Hot) without an app window. magicnum only opens on long-press of a number key. scheduler and notificationcenter are user-opened only.

LG account / privacy / terms / sign-in surfaces: firstuse (Terms & Conditions, User Analysis, User Agreements), firstuse-overlay (target eula), membership and overlaymembership (hosted membership.lgwebostv.com page), remoteservice (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy), self-diagnosis (consent to transmit info for support call), settings (Privacy & Terms, User Report consent), sportsteamsettings, helpandtips, universalqcard/learning (Go to LG Account prompts), picturewizard/soundwizard (save to LG account), signlanguage-avatar (terms for data download), notificationcenter (launches membership), billing service (opens membership query=billing), voice Voice ID (membership).

Network/LG-server dependent and likely empty or erroring on Nitin's TV (LG ads/telemetry blocked): universalqcard family + learning (admanager slots, qcard shelf download), helpandtips (Tips fetch), sportsteamsettings, weatherlocation, membership/overlaymembership (remote page), self-diagnosis support call, remoteservice.

Not reachable on a US OLED65C4PUA: svcdiagnostics (hold InStart in Quick Help, country KOR only), signlanguage-avatar (menu language must be Korean; not even in listApps), notificationcenter button (ScreenRemote shows it only for countryGroup JP), customersupport phone numbers (KOR only), softwareupdate (KOR or expert flag).

Hidden/privileged menus: installation (Settings IP Control Settings behind PIN or hotel mode; HotelModeInterfaces) and factorywin (factory IR keys via invokeFactoryWin, 299 QML files) are installer/service menus, no Magic Remote path. store-demo and sync-demo only run in Store Mode (settings store mode is 'home' on first use path).

tvhotkey is one native QML popup process with ~20 activateType modes (sleep, aspect-ratio, factory-picture/sound-mode, energy-saving, subtitle, audio-description, simplink, freesync-info, store-mode, switching-hub, bendable-setting, led-calibrator, one-local-key, mute-hidden-action). Sleep/aspect/picture keys can instead be routed to QuickSettings via sleepAction/aspectRatioAction config; Magic Remote lacks most of these keys.

Source gaps: web bundles (main.js, resources) are not in /tmp/tvsrc; English strings were taken from main.js/resources read single-file from the TV (copies in /tmp/SurfaceAudit.AppsSettingsWizards/js and strs). chromecast-settings has no index.html on the mounted squashfs, so its UI is unknown; sync-demo, weatherlocation and cmp-client have little or no readable UI text. Sizes: chromecast-settings and membership have no size_kb or appsize (n/a).

Wizards that need hardware or a specific setup: onetouchsoundtuning and btsurroundautotuning require a Magic Remote (mic/pointer) and, for BT, Bluetooth speakers; soundbar-setting only controls an LG soundbar (Denon AVR on eARC is not covered); picturewizard/soundwizard refuse when Sound Out/picture features conflict and can write to the LG account profile.
